cards.title: Why it works
items: Blindness by position: seats are fan-out children of the same wave and never see each other's answers
The adjudicator counts voices FROM review.all_results - a silent seat becomes a NAMED missing row, never unanimity
The report rides after_partial: a damaged adjudication still prints, red, instead of darkening the run

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{echoes}} echo, {{fanouts}} fan-out: docket -> blind review barrier (no quorum) -> adjudicate -> report
No seeds needed: the claims under review ride inside the docket, so the shape runs as-is on a fresh install
